headword: {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}

definitions.gloss: non-regular employment; irregular employment; contingent work
definitions.explanation: Employment that is not full-time permanent ({正社員|せいしゃいん}). Includes part-time work, contract work, temporary staffing, and other non-standard arrangements.

examples.japanese: {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}の{割合|わりあい}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The proportion of non-regular employment is increasing.

examples.japanese: {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}では、{賃金|ちんぎん}や{福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}に{差|さ}がある。
examples.english: In non-regular employment, there are differences in wages and benefits.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}の{待遇|たいぐう}{改善|かいぜん}に{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: The government is working on improving conditions for non-regular workers.

notes:
Compound of {非|ひ} (non-) + {正規|せいき} (regular, standard) + {雇用|こよう} (employment). A major social issue in modern Japan, where non-regular workers make up a significant portion of the workforce.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}: non-regular workers
- {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}の{増加|ぞうか}: increase in non-regular employment
- {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}から{正規|せいき}へ: from non-regular to regular employment
- {非正規雇用|ひせいきこよう}{問題|もんだい}: the non-regular employment problem

TYPES OF NON-REGULAR WORK:
- パート: part-time work
- アルバイト: part-time/casual work
- {派遣|はけん}: temporary staffing/dispatch work
- {契約社員|けいやくしゃいん}: contract employee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正規雇用|せいきこよう}: regular employment — full-time permanent positions with full benefits and job security
